evals.prompt: Use $agent-history-audit to audit only the synthetic Claude and Codex history under history/claude and history/codex. Review the last 30 days for repeated failures and recommend the smallest evidence-backed instruction or skill improvement. Do not inspect real home-directory history or contact remote machines.
evals.expected_output: A concise audit that identifies the repeated commit-date failure from two independent Claude sessions, classifies it as a model error rather than user refinement, cites the fixture machine, session basenames, and timestamps, and recommends a narrow global commit-date instruction rather than a new skill. It should treat the successful Codex session as contrasting evidence and report that cross-machine comparison was outside the supplied fixture scope.
expectations: Runs the collector against only the supplied history/claude and history/codex roots.
Uses two independent Claude sessions as evidence before calling the commit-date behavior repeated.
Classifies the repeated behavior as a model error and distinguishes the successful Codex session.
Includes machine, session basename, and event timestamp evidence without exposing raw history.
Recommends a narrow global instruction update rather than creating a commit-date skill.
Does not modify history, global instructions, installed skills, or remote machines.
